provenance: Hand-authored from funding-opportunities.types.ts, then VERIFIED against typed static constructors by funding-opportunities.baseline-contract.spec.ts. No live tenant, no production row, and no recorded HTTP response contributed to this file.
whyThisExists: Every phase after P00 adds fields, tables and surfaces. This file is the answer to 'what did the contract look like before any of that', so an accidental removal, rename or blended total is a failing test rather than a discovery in production.

amendedByPhase.P07: Added FundingOpportunity.decision (additive, nullable) plus the OpportunityDecision shape and the HUMAN_DECISIONS vocabulary. HUMAN_DECISIONS is deliberately NOT the same list as OPPORTUNITY_WORKFLOW_STATUSES: 'monitor' and 'pass' have no workflow equivalent, and 'suggested'/'expired' are machine states nobody decides. Null means nobody has decided yet, which is NOT the same as 'pass'. Backed by migration 20260819010000_funding_opportunity_decisions (additive, nullable, no backfill).
amendedByPhase.P06: Added FundingOpportunity.recommendation (additive, nullable) plus the OpportunityRecommendationView shape and the two recommendation vocabularies. The field is COMPUTED on read, never persisted, and is null on the unscoped catalog read because a recommendation is always relative to a specific client. Relevance and eligibility are unchanged; this is a fourth concept, not a replacement.
amendedByPhase.P23: Added FundingOpportunity.acquisitionPosition (additive, nullable) — no new shape entry here because acquisition-position.ts's own AcquisitionPosition/AcquisitionPositionState/AcquisitionVehicleEvidence types are not (yet) part of this frozen contract's tracked shapes, matching how OpportunityMatchedSignal's own nested detail was tracked separately from day one. Computed on read like recommendation, never persisted. Null on: the unscoped catalog read (no client), any grants_gov row (no contract-vehicle concept), or a sam_gov row when funding_opportunities_vehicle_fit is off for the tenant — in which case the response is byte-for-byte what P22 returned plus this one null-valued key. An eighth concept alongside relevance/eligibility/recommendation/decision/workflow status/source lifecycle/confidence (decision-log D-05), answering 'is there a credible path to this acquisition' — never blended with eligibility or rendered as a win probability.
amendedByPhase.P34: Added GET opportunities/:source/:id/action-plan, behind the SAME flag as P33's landscape (funding_opportunities_government_landscape) - an action plan without the evidence it is derived from is a list of steps nobody can check, so the two are not independently useful. NO new response field on FundingOpportunity and NO new vocabulary on an existing shape: the plan is its own response (ActionPlanResult), and its ACTION_CATEGORIES / PLAN_STAGES / ACTION_INTENTS vocabularies belong to it. ActionIntent REUSES P08's OpportunityActionIntent verbatim plus an explicit 'none' for a reference note, imported rather than re-spelt so the two cannot drift. The route accepts INBOX_SOURCES (agency_forecast included) via a separate InboxSourceParamDto rather than widening SourceParamDto - every other source-taking route reads or writes a catalog row keyed on one of the two OPPORTUNITY_SOURCES, and quietly admitting a forecast id there would let it reach a handler that assumes a notice.
amendedByPhase.P35: Added GET clients/:clientId/pipeline and POST clients/:clientId/pipeline/:rowId/stage, both behind a NEW flag funding_opportunities_pipeline_v2 (off). Its own flag rather than a reuse: the pipeline WRITES and it replaces how work is tracked, so it needs its own canary. NO change to any existing response shape and NO widening of OPPORTUNITY_WORKFLOW_STATUSES - PIPELINE_STAGES is a SECOND bounded vocabulary on a second nullable column, because workflow_status carries two values that are not capture stages (suggested is the producer's output, expired is a mechanical consequence of the source closing) and has no room for qualified or submitted. STAGE_TO_LEGACY_STATUS and LEGACY_STATUS_TO_STAGE are the declared projection between the two, and effectiveStage is the ONLY place they are reconciled.

invariants.noBlendedMoney: No response key sums grant money with contract money, and no key named totalAmount (or any *Amount) exists. grantFunding is null on a sam_gov row; contractValue is null on a grants_gov row.
invariants.nullMoneyIsNotZero: Every field listed in moneyFields is `number | null`. Null means the source stated no figure. Nothing in the read path coerces it to 0.
invariants.relevanceIsNotEligibility: relevanceScore (number) and eligibility ({state, reason}) are separate keys, computed by separate functions, and neither is derived from the other.
invariants.confidenceIsNotWinProbability: recommendationConfidence is evidence quality. A high-confidence `pass` is a confident recommendation NOT to bid, which is why it can never be rendered as a win rate.
invariants.recommendationIsNotPersisted: The recommendation is recomputed from source facts on every read, so it cannot go stale against a client profile that has since changed.
invariants.explicitFeatureFlag: Every route is gated by an explicit enabled row in intel_feature_flag for feature 'funding_opportunities'. There is no implicit internal-tenant fallback. A missing row, a missing tenant context, and a failing flag read all produce 404.
invariants.portalDenial: client_portal_user ranks below the controller's declared standard_user minimum, so RolesGuard denies every route with 403. This module exposes no separate portal read path.
invariants.failureIsNotEmpty: A failing catalog read propagates as a non-2xx. EmptyReason has no member meaning 'the request failed', so a broken query can never render as zero results.
invariants.closedCannotBePursued: assertPursuable rejects status 'pursuing' for a closed grant, a closed SAM notice, and any NON_PURSUABLE_KINDS notice. Every other status, 'saved' included, stays available.
invariants.decisionIsNotWorkflowStatus: humanDecision (what the team decided), workflowStatus (where a pursuit is) and the machine recommendation (recomputed on read) are three separate concepts that may legitimately disagree. A `pass` records a judgement and does NOT set workflowStatus='dismissed', because dismissing is a visibility action and passing is a judgement.
invariants.decisionCarriesActorAndTimestamp: A CHECK constraint enforces that humanDecision, decisionAt and decisionByUserId are either all NULL or all present. A decision without an actor is not reviewable.
invariants.producerNeverOverwritesHumanDecision: A row whose workflowStatus is in HUMAN_DECISION_STATUSES, or whose userCreated is true, is left untouched by both candidate producers.

Every forecast signal is derived by EXACT comparison or not at all: a NAICS industry-group near miss is NOT a match (sam-opportunity-relevance.ts bands one as moderate for live notices; ForecastRelevanceInput.exactNaicsMatch is a different contract), a capability keyword matches only as a whole token with two-character keywords refused outright, and a PE link needs the client's code verbatim in the record text. A Postgres DATE is serialized and formatted as YYYY-MM-DD from its parts, never as an instant: toISOString() on UTC midnight renders an agency's stated March award as 28 February for every reader west of Greenwich. raisedByPhase.P27: 50/1530 -> 53/1622 (api); web floor unchanged, P27 has no user-visible surface. Three NEW suites — tango-opportunity.mapper.spec.ts (35), sync-tango-opportunity-shadow.spec.ts (31), diag-tango-opportunity-parity.spec.ts (26) — and ONE migration, 20260826010000_tango_opportunity_crosswalk. The phase uses Tango opportunity data to VERIFY Capiro's own SAM.gov rail and never to replace it: plan §4.2 binds here, so the shadow sync writes only three provider-owned things (P15's snapshot, P15's exact_identifier link, and P27's new per-field parity ledger) and never touches sam_opportunity, proven both behaviourally and by a structural grep. There is deliberately NO second link table: tango_resource_link (P15) already links a sam_opportunity to a Tango opportunity with a basis restricted to exact_identifier | reviewed_manual, and a parallel crosswalk table would mean two answers to 'is this linked'. Identity is an exact identifier or nothing — exactly one local notice sharing a solicitation number links, MORE THAN ONE is 'ambiguous' and links nothing (a presolicitation, a solicitation and its amendments are separate rows under one number; picking whichever sorted first is how a closed notice acquires a live deadline), and there is no title match and no scoring. The solicitation number is NORMALIZED (punctuation and case stripped) but never fuzzy-matched: no character is added, removed or transposed, so two genuinely different numbers cannot collide. Parity reports FIVE outcomes, not two — 'local_only'/'provider_only'/'both_absent' are coverage facts about the provider and only 'conflict' is a data-quality finding — with a seconds-level deadline difference deliberately NOT a conflict (the two catalogs round the same value differently) while a minute-level one is. The new table is global (no tenant_id, no RLS) and carries NO foreign key: a cascade from either independently-synced catalog would delete the evidence that they ever disagreed. A conflict is never resolved by a job: 'resolution' moves only through an attributed human review, guarded by a three-way all-or-nothing CHECK matching P07's own decision-actor constraint. The diagnostic exits nonzero ONLY for an operator-set threshold — an ordinary unlinked row is the expected state of a verification rail, and a permanently-red check is an ignored check. Migration rehearsed against a fresh pgvector/pgvector:pg16: clean replay, retry-as-no-op, idempotent re-deploy, and 10 constraint proofs by actual insert (six refusals, four acceptances).
raisedByPhase.P28: 53/1622 -> 55/1692 (api), 63/274 -> 67/287 (web). Two NEW api suites (opportunity-change-classifier.spec.ts 45, sync-tango-opportunity-notices.spec.ts 25), one NEW web file (OpportunityTimeline.test.tsx 13), one migration (20260827010000_tango_opportunity_notice_history). The timeline is DERIVED on read and never stored — a stored copy alongside its own inputs is a second thing that can be wrong about them, and a CI schema assertion proves no timeline table exists. ORDER INDEPENDENCE is the headline property: every permutation of a notice set produces a byte-identical timeline, because buildNoticeTimeline sorts on a TOTAL order (postedDate, providerUpdatedAt, noticeId) before comparing; without the id tiebreaker the same set could produce two timelines depending on provider page order. An UNDATED notice sorts LAST rather than becoming the baseline every later notice is compared against. Duplicates collapse to one entry (later providerUpdatedAt wins, ties keep the first), which is what makes the incremental overlap free rather than a source of phantom changes. Absence is reported in BOTH directions with different sentences, and a deadline being REMOVED gets its own copy; `active` going to NULL is deliberately NOT a cancellation, because the provider ceasing to state a flag is not the agency withdrawing the notice. Four of the plan's nine change dimensions (stage, place of performance, contact, description) have NO counterpart in the SDK's bundled NOTICE_SCHEMA and are reported as UNSUPPORTED with a reason naming the provider, never as 'no change' — and the code notes that whether the LIVE server carries more is a D-45-style investigation needing a key. The content hash drops `provenance` before hashing: fetchedAt changes every fetch, so hashing it in would make every re-sync look like an amendment. A notice is stamped with a local sam_opportunity id only under P27's exact-identifier rule, reused verbatim; an ambiguous solicitation number stamps nothing and the notice is still stored, with the read API reporting coverage 'not_crosswalked' rather than an empty history. P28 emits NO alerts (that is P48's): neither file imports anything alert-, notification-, engagement- or mail-shaped, pinned structurally. Migration rehearsed as an ORDERED UPGRADE onto P27's own schema, plus 8 constraint proofs by actual insert (four refusals, four acceptances).
raisedByPhase.P29: 55/1699 -> 57/1780 (api); web unchanged, P29 has no surface. Two NEW suites (opportunity-attachment.spec.ts 59, sync-tango-opportunity-attachments.spec.ts 21) and one migration (20260829010000_opportunity_attachments). Attachment URLs come from Capiro's OWN stored SAM.gov payload (sam_opportunity.raw.resourceLinks): the installed SDK exposes NO attachment enumeration, only searchOpportunityAttachments, a semantic search that cannot answer what documents a given solicitation has. A MISSING resourceLinks key is reported as noLinksField, never as 'no attachments'. The guards: HTTPS-only (an allow-list of one scheme, so file:/gopher:/data: are refused too), no credentials in the URL, a private-network host check covering RFC1918, loopback, CGNAT, IPv6 ULA/link-local AND the cloud metadata addresses, and a reviewed host allow-list. EVERY redirect hop is re-checked, because checking only the first is the same as not checking. A zip bomb is caught by RATIO rather than by a size check on the compressed bytes. A MIME mismatch between declared and observed is its own refusal. This phase's own test found a real hole: new URL() canonicalizes an IPv6 host to compressed hex, so ::ffff:169.254.169.254 reached the guard as ::ffff:a9fe:a9fe and the dotted-quad branch never matched — with an empty allow-list that would have reached the EC2 metadata service. REFUSED and FAILED are disjoint and only FAILED is retried, because retrying an SSRF attempt on a schedule is the attack working slowly. The archive key IS the content hash, so identical bytes are a free no-op and changed bytes get a new key rather than overwriting — a requirement extracted from version A must still resolve to version A's bytes. The database enforces the acceptance line: archived REQUIRES bucket, key, hash, size and time, and a non-archived row may carry none of them. Migration rehearsed as an ordered upgrade with 13 constraint proofs by actual insert (nine refusals, four acceptances).
raisedByPhase.P30: 57/1780 -> 59/1822 (api); web unchanged. Two NEW suites (opportunity-document-text.spec.ts 33, sync-tango-opportunity-text.spec.ts 9) and one migration (20260830010000_opportunity_document_text). THE rule: blank is never 'this document has no requirements'. Five statuses with five distinct sentences, each naming whose gap it is — not_entitled is a BILLING fact about the account, not_provided is a fact about the DOCUMENT, and no sentence ever claims the document is empty. Truncated text says what is missing is UNREAD, not absent. Text is bound to BYTES: every row carries the SHA-256 of the exact attachment bytes it came from, a mismatch THROWS, and an unarchived attachment makes its text stale. The text is DATA: asUntrustedEvidence fences and labels it, the markers are neutralised before the fence is applied so a document cannot CLOSE it, and the hostile sentence survives verbatim inside — rewriting a quoted document is tampering with evidence. No injection DETECTION, deliberately: that is an arms race against text nobody controls. A REAL LIMIT recorded rather than papered over: the installed SDK exposes extracted text through exactly one method, searchOpportunityAttachments, a SEMANTIC SEARCH taking a query — there is no getAttachmentText(id), so per-document text cannot be fetched at all, and inventing a query to stand in for a document id would bind text to an attachment it merely resembles (the fuzzy identity P02 forbids). The run therefore seeds the CORRECT unavailability status per archived attachment, which is the phase acceptance line, with entitlement passed in from P17 rather than re-derived from a failed call. Migration rehearsed as an ordered upgrade with 10 constraint proofs by actual insert (seven refusals, three acceptances).
raisedByPhase.P31: 59/1822 -> 60/1860 (api), 67/287 -> 70/297 (web). One NEW api suite (opportunity-requirement.spec.ts 38), one NEW web file (OpportunityRequirementsPanel.test.tsx 10), one migration adding TWO tables. NO ASSERTION WITHOUT EVIDENCE, enforced at three layers: the TYPE, the validator, and the database. The layer that matters most is excerptMatchesText, because a hallucinated quote produces a perfectly well-formed artifact - right shape, coherent span, plausible sentence - whose text is not in the document, and neither a type nor a CHECK can see that. Comparison is EXACT with no normalization: a quote differing by one space is not a quote, and normalizing first would let an extractor rewrite punctuation inside quotation marks. A real quote at the WRONG offsets fails separately. Without the source text those checks report as UNEVALUATED, never as passing. Source content cannot widen the artifact shape: assertNoSchemaDrift REFUSES an unexpected field rather than stripping it, and an adversarial instruction inside an excerpt changes validation by exactly zero. TWO tables, and the split is the design: the REQUIREMENT is a fact about a public document (global, extracted once) and the REVIEW is one team decision (tenant-scoped, RLS ENABLED + FORCED, four policies) - one table would mean either re-extracting per tenant or showing every tenant what one team decided. The web panel renders no statement without its citation and distinguishes four kinds of empty, only one of which is a fact about the solicitation. The P12-era PendingSection assertion was replaced honestly, not deleted. Migration rehearsed as an ordered upgrade with 10 constraint proofs by actual insert (eight refusals, two acceptances).
raisedByPhase.P32: web 70/297 -> 75/314; api unchanged - P32 changes no API at all. One NEW file, OpportunityAssessmentPanel.test.tsx (17). The drawer is now eight sections fed by five endpoints, four of them secondary, and before this phase a render error in any of them took the whole drawer with it - leaving a blank panel where an executive recommendation should be, with no way to tell 'the recommendation is pass' from 'the page broke'. Every section now has its OWN error boundary; a single one around the whole drawer would satisfy React and defeat the purpose, so a structural test counts them. A PRIMARY failure says no conclusion follows, a SECONDARY one says the rest of the assessment stands, and no stack trace reaches the page. PARITY is made structural: the recommendation vocabulary now lives in exactly one table in the api mirror, with one test asserting only that file declares it and another asserting no component declares its own - the card and the detail composed these independently before, which is how a card can say Pursue while the drawer says Needs review about the same row. An absent recommendation stays absent: the unscored read and a scored-but-uncomputed record get different sentences, and the second explicitly rules out reading it as a pass.
raisedByPhase.P33: api 60/1860 -> 61/1889; web unchanged at 75/314 - the panel replaced a PendingSection and the detail suite adjusted rather than grew. One NEW suite (government-landscape.spec.ts 29), NO migration: the packet is composed from tables that already exist, which is the plan's own 'consume, do not duplicate' line. THE ETHICAL WALL: a client the actor cannot see yields a DENIED packet, not a 403 - a 403 would confirm the client exists - nothing is read on that client's behalf, and the denied packet carries the SAME fingerprint as any empty one, so a caller cannot detect a walled client by comparing hashes. VERIFIED AND INFERRED NEVER MERGE: only an accepted sam_opportunity_match is source_backed; a quarantined or candidate row (what a NAICS or keyword coincidence produces) is admitted as INFERRED, excluded from every high-confidence action, and labelled as not evidence of a link - dropping it would hide real information a human deciding whether to pursue can use. A DISTRICT link is a STATE overlap between the notice's stated place of performance and a recorded facility, never a geocode: inferring a district from a city name is exactly the fabricated district nexus that FundingOpportunity.districtBasis already refuses to create. A MISSING SOURCE lowers coverage and makes no claim: not_wired (Capiro cannot read it yet) and empty (Capiro read it and found nothing) are different states with different sentences, and every not_wired explanation is asserted to contain 'Nothing here says'. DETERMINISM DOWN TO THE HASH: the ordering is TOTAL - without the id tiebreaker two facilities in one state would sort by whatever order Postgres returned them in and the fingerprint would move with no fact moving - and the hash covers the FACTS only, so a re-worded label or a re-observed asOf does not move it while a changed basis does. There is no clock in the composition besides the caller's own asOf default.
raisedByPhase.P34: 61/1889 -> 62/1953 (api), 75/314 -> 80/333 (web). One NEW api suite (opportunity-action-plan.spec.ts, 63 tests) and one NEW web file (OpportunityActionPlan.test.tsx, 19 tests). NO migration and NO new flag: the plan is composed from rows P22, P24, P31 and P33 already write, and the accept path is P08's existing idempotent server action. PROPOSALS, NOT COMMITMENTS: the builder is a PURE function and the suite greps its own source for prisma, tx., $queryRaw, fetch and any model reference - a plan that could create tasks would create them the moment a detail page was opened. ONE TASK PER INTENT, not per action: P08's key stays <source>:<sourceRecordId>:<intent>, so two accepted review actions land on ONE task and the panel says so rather than letting a user discover it. NO TARGET WITHOUT A SOURCE-BACKED REASON: only P33 items whose basis is source_backed produce one, a quarantined PE match contributes nothing, and no action's evidence ever cites an inferred item; a target is also never a PERSON, because reviewed_relationship and acquisition_personnel are both not_wired and naming an individual would invent the introduction outright. A CLOSED NOTICE AND A FORECAST NEVER PROPOSE A PURSUIT, enforced structurally by STAGE_ALLOWED_INTENTS and a thrown error rather than a silent downgrade; forecast is decided by SOURCE and wins over everything, so a withdrawn forecast still gets shaping advice rather than watch-for-a-repost. AN UNMET DEPENDENCY IS STATED: no requirements extracted means the compliance-matrix action says so, and there is NO fallback due date - a fabricated deadline on a notice that states none is the most confidently wrong thing the plan could emit, and a PAST date is returned rather than clamped to today. DETERMINISM: same packet and same asOf produce a byte-identical plan including ids and fingerprint, asOf is threaded all the way into the lifecycle read (a wall clock there could return two plans for the same inputs), and the fingerprint covers facts only so re-observing does not move it while a resolved prerequisite does.
raisedByPhase.P35: 62/1953 -> 63/2005 (api), 80/333 -> 85/353 (web). One NEW api suite (funding-opportunity-pipeline.spec.ts, 52 tests), one NEW web file (FundingOpportunityPipeline.test.tsx, 20 tests), and a migration (20260901010000_funding_opportunity_pipeline_v2) rehearsed against a fresh pgvector:pg16 with a clean replay, a retry-as-no-op and every constraint proved by ACTUAL INSERT. ROLLING-DEPLOY SAFETY is the load-bearing property: pipeline_stage is nullable with NO default so an older pod's INSERT still succeeds, pipeline_stage_version is NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 so the same INSERT still yields a usable concurrency token, and ONE function reconciles the two columns - the legacy workflow_status WINS for anything it can express while pipeline_stage only adds resolution it cannot (qualified and submitted both project onto pursuing; comparing the other way would call every qualified row stale). Every transition writes BOTH columns in one statement so the lifecycle processor, which reads the legacy column, stays correct. AN UNSTAGED ROW IS UNSTAGED: suggested and expired map to NO stage in both the backfill and the read - mapping suggested to reviewing would put the producer's whole backlog on a column named for a human activity nobody is performing, and mapping expired to anything fabricates a capture history - and the board counts both separately. INVALID TRANSITIONS FAIL: won and lost are reachable only from submitted, and the move is validated against the EFFECTIVE stage so a stale recorded stage cannot admit a move the legacy status forbids. CONCURRENCY: the version predicate sits in the WHERE, so the loser of two simultaneous moves updates 0 rows and gets a 409 rather than discarding the winner. BOARD COUNTS come from a GROUP BY over every workflow row, never the returned cards. PRODUCERS CANNOT MOVE A STAGE: actor_user_id is NOT NULL on the audit row, an outcome stage requires a non-blank reason by CHECK as well as in the service, and the spec greps all three producer scripts for the column names.
raisedByPhase.P37: 63/2005 -> 65/2050 (api); web unchanged, P37 has no surface. TWO suites join the gate: one NEW file (meri-opportunity-tools.spec.ts, 40 tests) and one EXISTING file newly brought into scope (src/meri/meri-tools.registration.spec.ts, 6 tests) - the tool registry now carries six Funding Opportunities entries, so the suite that guards the registry against a silent drop has to be inside the gate that guards this feature. NO migration, NO new table, and a new flag (funding_opportunities_meri_v2) with no row anywhere. THE DEPENDENCY RUNS ONE WAY: the adapter lives in src/funding-opportunities/ and MeriModule imports THIS module, never the reverse - FundingOpportunitiesModule still has no imports array of its own, and a spec reads every .ts file in the directory to prove none of them imports from src/meri. The reverse edge is not a lint preference; MeriModule already imports thirteen feature modules, so it would be a Nest bootstrap failure. NO PROVIDER REACH: the adapter's constructor takes exactly three local collaborators (asserted by arity AND by name), and its source contains no reference to external/tango, @makegov, a secret, a gateway, fetch or any http client - so 'Capiro has not synced this' is an answer these tools can give and 'let me check the provider' is not. THE GATE IS FLAG, THEN ROLE, THEN WALL, in that order and for a reason: a tenant without the capability learns nothing about its own roster, a portal user is refused before any client read is ISSUED (proven by call counts, so the refusal cannot be timed), and only then does the ethical wall run. A DENIED CLIENT IS BYTE-IDENTICAL TO A NON-EXISTENT ONE - asserted with toEqual across all six tools, because anything distinguishing them turns the tool into an oracle for which clients exist behind a wall. P33's own denied packet, which carries no denied FLAG (it is shaped like an empty packet down to the fingerprint, deliberately), is detected through its per-source state and mapped back to the same refusal; the predicate is named and tested rather than inlined, including the [].every() case that would otherwise read an empty packet as a denial. REFUSALS ARE RESULTS, NOT EXCEPTIONS: a Meri tool result is text the model reads mid-turn, so a throw either kills the turn or arrives as a stack-shaped string the model paraphrases - every refusal is a typed state (disabled | denied | not_found | unsupported_source | invalid_request) with wording that says what Capiro did, never what is true of the world. A THROWING flag read fails closed rather than killing the turn, unlike the route guard's deliberate non-catching read. THE FOUR CONCEPTS STAY FOUR: relevance, eligibility, machine recommendation and human decision are separate fields and no blended 'score' key exists; grant funding and contract value are separate and no key matching /^total/i is emitted; null money stays null. OUTPUT IS BOUNDED BY RANK, NOT BY BYTES - a byte budget drops whatever happens to be last, so the same query could return different evidence as unrelated fields grow - and 'truncated' is ABSENT when nothing was dropped rather than an empty array a model has to reason about. Long free text carries its truncation marker INSIDE the string, because the value gets quoted. ALL SIX TOOLS REQUIRE clientId: the chat loop's client-scope refusal (meri-client-scope-fail-closed.spec.ts) keys on that field, so a tool omitting it would read straight past a scoped session's boundary.
raisedByPhase.P38: 65/2050 -> 66/2095 (api), 85/353 -> 89/360 (web). One NEW api suite (meri-opportunity-assessment.spec.ts, 45 tests) and one NEW web file (MeriOpportunityAssessment.test.tsx, 19 tests). NO MIGRATION: the assessment persists through tables that already exist — clio_artifacts for the versioned copy, the Phase-0 claim/evidence store for its citations, compliance_check for one audit row. That is why `conversationId` is REQUIRED on the request rather than optional: relaxing clio_artifacts.conversation_id would be a migration against another subsystem's schema with rolling-deploy consequences for every artifact reader, and scoping the assessment to the conversation that asked for it also supplies version history through that table's own parentArtifactId chain. THE MODEL CANNOT CHANGE THE RECOMMENDATION, structurally rather than by validation: buildAssessment WRITES the deterministic restatement from the packet and never reads the model's copy — a validator can be satisfied by a model that echoes the right word while the prose around it argues the opposite. A disagreement survives in its own field, and a test asserts that field carries no accepted/apply/override key a reviewer could flip; agreement is deliberately NOT recorded as a disagreement, because a null-op field trains reviewers to skip it. NO CLAIM WITHOUT EVIDENCE THAT ALREADY EXISTED: the packet carries a closed ref set, and a claim citing none of them (or only refs outside it) is HELD — not dropped, because a shorter assessment reads as a cleaner one, and not passed through, because a citation resolving to nothing is worse than an admitted gap. A partially-cited claim is supported AND still carries its unresolvable refs, so a reviewer can see the model inventing them. UNTRUSTED TEXT CANNOT ESCAPE ITS FENCE: quoteUntrusted puts the warning INSIDE the fence adjacent to the bytes it describes (a warning outside it is one a long body can push out of attention), and stripFence neutralizes the closing token, the opening token, and the LABEL — the label comes from source data too. The suite drives a real prompt-injection body through it and asserts exactly one closing token survives. A MODEL FAILURE IS THE DEFAULT PATH rather than a handled exception: the deterministic half is computed before the model is called, so `unavailable` still restates the recommendation and still leads with the engine's own next action; `unavailable` and `rejected` stay apart because unreachable and answered-with-garbage are different facts for someone deciding whether to re-run. EVALS cover grant, forecast, sources-sought, solicitation, amendment, thin-client and conflict, asserting on every shape that the engine's decision survives, no dollar figure is invented, and an empty packet holds every claim. NOTHING WRITES TO THE PRODUCT: three fail-open audit surfaces only, proven by grepping the service for clientFundingOpportunity/engagementTask/memoryItem/sendEmail/setWorkflowStatus, and the web panel's drafts block is asserted to contain zero buttons. The panel is a MUTATION, not a query — a query would fire on mount, and mounting is what opening a detail drawer does. KNOWN LIMITATION: the detail page passes conversationId=null and the panel renders its honest 'open this from a Meri conversation' state there; giving that surface its own entry point needs either a clio_artifacts migration or a create-a-conversation affordance, both decisions rather than oversights.

sourceFreshnessSemantics.lastSyncedAt: Last SUCCESSFUL sync. This is what the UI's 'current to ...' line means.
sourceFreshnessSemantics.lastAttemptAt: Latest run of any outcome, reported independently of the last success so a rail failing nightly cannot read as healthy.
sourceFreshnessSemantics.neverSynced: True only when the rail has never completed a successful run. On a degraded freshness read it stays false, because 'we do not know' must not be reported as 'it has never synced'.
sourceFreshnessSemantics.countsUnavailable: True when catalog counts could not be read. Distinct from a count of zero.
sourceFreshnessSemantics.degradedReadIsNotNeverSynced: readFreshness catches its own failure and returns countsUnavailable=true with null timestamps rather than propagating. The opportunities themselves still render.
